letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or the gentle breezes of Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. I still remember the sparkle in your eyes on that magical day in February, and each moment since has been a sweet adventure. You’re my cutie, my confidante, the melody that makes my heart dance. Thank you for filling our home with love, laughter, and endless warmth—today and always. I love you more than words can hold.
poem:
In every city’s glow, your smile’s my guide,  
Across the dunes or riverside we stride.  
Your love’s a song that never ends,  
My heart, my home—my forever friend.
